get.description: This API fetches the details of a particular help center user.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Additional information related to the user. Value allowed is @contact@.

parameters.name: helpCenterId
parameters.description: ID of the help center from which the user must be fetched

patch.description: This API helps update the details of a particular help center user.

parameters.name: helpCenterId
parameters.description: ID of the help center from which the user must be updated

parameters.name: helpCenterId
parameters.description: ID of the help center from which the groups must be validated

get.description: This API lists a particular number of labels associated with a user, based on the limit defined.

parameters.name: isPrimary
parameters.description: Key that filters the primary label assigned to the user

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number, starting from which the labels must be fetched. The default value is 1

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of labels to list. The default value and the maximum value allowed is 50

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Key that sorts the list of labels by a particular attribute: -(@assignedTime@)

parameters.name: searchBy
parameters.description: Search keyword to use for finding a particular user. The keyword must contain at least two characters.

parameters.name: helpCenterId
parameters.description: ID of the help center from which the labels must be fetched

post.description: This API removes the labels you specify from a particular user.

parameters.name: helpCenterId
parameters.description: ID of the help center from which the labels must be removed

post.description: This API removes a user from the groups specified.

parameters.name: helpCenterId
parameters.description: ID of the help center from which the groups must be removed

post.description: This API permanently deletes all identifying information about a user from your help center.

get.description: This API lists a particular number of help center users, based on the limit defined. It also helps you search for specific users.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number, starting from which the users must be fetched. The default value is 1

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of users to be listed. The default and the maximum allowed value is 50

parameters.name: searchBy
parameters.description: Search keyword to find a particular user. Note: The keyword must contain at least two characters

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Key that sorts the list of users by a particular attribute: -(@email@ or @modifiedTime@)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Activation status of the users to list

parameters.name: helpCenterId
parameters.description: ID of the help center from which the users must be fetched

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Additional information related to the user. Value allowed is @count@.

schema.description: Additional information related to the user. Value allowed is @count@.

parameters.name: lastActivityStartTime
parameters.description: Starting time of the time range in which the comments should have been created. The value must be expressed according to the GMT time zone.

parameters.name: helpCenterId

get.description: This API lists a particular number of user groups in a help center, based on the limit defined.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number, starting from which the groups must be fetched. The default value is 1

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of groups to list. The default value and the maximum value allowed is 50

parameters.name: searchBy
parameters.description: Search keyword to use for finding a particular user. The keyword must contain at least two characters.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Key that sorts the list of user groups by a particular attribute: -(@addedTime@)

parameters.name: helpCenterId
parameters.description: ID of the help center from which the groups must be fetched
